tool_args.rationale: The pilot has five observations for a four-parameter coupled ODE, while the mechanism note calls for at least eight rows. Additional trajectory observations are needed before numerical fitting and fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five rows leave insufficient evidence to identify and validate the four coupled parameters reliably.
The retrieved mechanism identifies a coupled memory ODE; the additional trajectory batch directly addresses its parameter-identification ambiguity.
They do not represent the observed history dependence and coupled transient lag.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the memory mechanism.
